name: I, Y, T (IYT) Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or floor with arms hanging or extended and thumbs up.
Raise your arms straight overhead to form an I, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower, then raise your arms at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Lower, then raise your arms out to the sides to form a T.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A prone sequence of arm raises that strengthens the lower traps, rear delts and shoulder stabilisers.
